INSPECTION OF PCV HOSE AND CONNECTIONS

1. VISUALLY INSPECT HOSE AND CONNECTIONS
Check for cracks, leaks or damage.

2. CLEAN ORIFICE(S)
Clean off any gum deposits in the orifice(s) with solvent and blow out with compressed air.
